subject: reasoning
question: Kishan starts from Point A and drives 15 km towards East. He then takes a right turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 8 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Kishan starts from Point A and drives 15 km towards East.
 
• He then takes a right turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 8 km.
 
• He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P.
